defects.quote: MDR Annex VIII – Rule 10 (radiology limb) → **Class IIb** for equipment that emits ionising radiation for diagnostic purposes.
defects.correct_fact: Rule 10 first indent classifies active devices intended to emit ionising radiation for diagnostic and therapeutic radiology (incl. interventional radiology) as Class IIb. The text is acceptable, but the answer states the rule for the whole system while later noting limbs may fall under other rules; this is internally consistent enough. Minor: Rule 10 also states 'unless' wording is not relevant here.
defects.basis: MDR Annex VIII, Rule 10

defects.quote: Each limb may fall under a different Rule (10 radiology vs 10 recording vs 11 software).
defects.correct_fact: Rule 10 (diagnostic and monitoring) and Rule 11 (software) are distinct rules; implementing rule 3.3 states that software driving or influencing a device takes the same class as that device. Treating the software as a separate classification limb is misleading, since software driving the X-ray device takes the device's class.
defects.basis: MDR Annex VIII, Chapter II, implementing rule 3.3

defects.quote: Labeling & IFU – Annex I §23
defects.correct_fact: Annex I Chapter III §23 covers the information supplied with the device (label and IFU). This is correct and is not a defect.
